analysis_type: Read-only post-hoc arithmetic decomposition of the five frozen Roszman1 fold-4 held-out predictions; no refitting, retuning or new experiment

rules.signed_residual: For either model, residual equals observed_y minus prediction
rules.absolute_delta: delta_i equals native absolute residual minus rational absolute residual; negative favors native and positive favors rational
rules.squared_delta: q_i equals native squared residual minus rational squared residual; negative favors native and positive favors rational
rules.aggregate_absolute: D1 equals the sum of delta_i; native MAE minus rational MAE must equal D1 divided by five
rules.aggregate_squared: D2 equals the sum of q_i; native MSE minus rational MSE must equal D2 divided by five, with MSE defined as RMSE squared
rules.weight_identity: For every point, q_i must equal delta_i multiplied by w_i, where w_i is native absolute residual plus rational absolute residual
rules.point_groups: Group points by the sign of delta_i; exact zero is retained as a tie and never forced into either winner
rules.weight_summary: Report raw residual-unit weights and their sums and means within each point group; do not convert them into probabilities or physical contributions
rules.leave_one_out: For each point, subtract only its delta_i and q_i from D1 and D2; this diagnoses metric arithmetic after removing that observation's contribution and is not model refitting
rules.direction_reversal: A removal reverses the native-lower-RMSE direction when the remaining D2 is nonnegative; it reverses the rational-lower-MAE direction when the remaining D1 is nonpositive; exact zero is labeled tie
rules.metric_recomputation: Recompute native and rational MAE, MSE and RMSE from all five stored predictions and require agreement with the frozen fold metrics
rules.reporting: Retain every point, raw sums, net deltas, weights and leave-one-out result; do not report only normalized shares or selected observations

output_rule.word: papers/前沿共生Roszman1第4折误差分解_图文完整版.docx

prohibitions: No refitting, changed predictions, changed fold membership or new starts
No interpretation of leave-one-out metric arithmetic as five refitted models
No causal, physical-mechanism, probability, confidence-interval or statistical-significance claim from five observations
No conversion of residual weights into posterior probabilities or universal model-selection rules
No claim that per-point absolute and squared residual preferences can disagree when both are computed from the same pair of absolute residuals
No native deterministic-bound, probability-calibration, independent-experiment or universal-model-ranking claim
No rewriting of the native holdout or cross-dataset synthesis inputs
